nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Index of the 2026-07-11 frontend UI consistency audit batch, tracking D1-D5 verdicts across five audited components (Anchor, WorktreeSourceModal, SessionInfoLine, AvatarChip, AgentStationChromeFrame) plus pending follow-ups and landed accessibility fixes.

nodes.name: AgentStationChromeFrame.md
nodes.summary: UI consistency audit of AgentStationChromeFrame.tsx covering a glow-animation class rename, finding the raw-HTML, token, and accessibility usage clean with three keep-with-reason arbitrary Tailwind values for a radial-gradient glow effect.

nodes.name: Anchor.md
nodes.summary: UI consistency audit of the Anchor section-navigation component (src/components/Anchor/index.tsx), finding it design-system-clean with one justified raw button and one deferred repo-wide typography micro-size candidate.

nodes.name: AvatarChip.md
nodes.summary: UI consistency audit of the AvatarChip design-system primitive after a readability/a11y refactor, noting a justified internal raw button, two deferred typography debt items, and a local cx() joiner flagged as a sweep candidate against the shared classNames util.

nodes.name: BackgroundLayer.md
nodes.summary: UI consistency audit of the BackgroundLayer native-macOS-sidebar rework across BackgroundLayer/index.tsx, modules/index.tsx, and SidebarBase.tsx, finding all raw div layers and inline geometry justified with documented reasons and zero required fixes.

nodes.name: ChatPanelStartPage.md
nodes.summary: UI consistency audit of the ChatPanelStartPage install-update quick-action addition, confirming it reuses the existing DS action-card button primitive, tokens, and icon sizing with zero fixes required.

nodes.name: PaneTransitions.md
nodes.summary: UI consistency audit of sidebar/workstation/chat pane open-close-resize transition behavior across viewContainerTokens, SidebarBase, AppLayout, and chat-resize hooks, recommending two fixes for a resize-handle overlap and a narrow-layout reopen width calculation.

nodes.name: SessionInfoLine.md
nodes.summary: UI consistency audit of SessionInfoLine and buildSessionInfoSegments focused on the worktree-source-selector touchpoints (location pill, modal mount, shortcut bridge), finding the files fully design-system-routed and accessible with zero fixes needed.

nodes.name: SidebarControlTokens.md
nodes.summary: UI consistency audit of selected/hover token usage across sidebar controls (org selector, filter button, settings menu, RAM monitor), recommending four fixes to migrate legacy primary-accent colors onto the shared sidebar selected-row token.

nodes.name: SidebarEdgeLayering.md
nodes.summary: UI consistency audit of the theme-aware macOS sidebar edge-depth boundary and its Appearance toggle, finding the shared SidebarBase rendering and per-theme CSS tokens correctly scoped with zero fixes required.

nodes.name: WorkstationLayout.md
nodes.summary: UI consistency audit of the workstation layout-density simplification (removing the compact/comfort choice), confirming the settings submenu, shell panels, properties rail, and status bar all reuse existing tokens with zero fixes required.

nodes.name: WorktreeSourceModal.md
nodes.summary: Extensive, multi-pass UI consistency audit of WorktreeSourceModal.tsx (grown to 967 LOC) tracking the branch/smart-tab reworks, list-item visual unification, a data/cache/refresh layer, and five landed accessibility fixes (ARIA tabs, alert roles, label associations, DS Input migration).
nodes.languageNotes: Living audit document accreting multiple dated follow-up passes (2026-07-11 through 2026-07-12) rather than being rewritten, so it doubles as a change log for the audited component.
